notes.title: A New Face…and a New Style!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’ve reworked one of the enemy pirates. As I improve as a 3D modeller, I’ve been searching for a visual style that feels more personal, blending a stylized approach with the steampunk soul of the game.

The new model reflects exactly that: gears, brass details, and a slightly more cartoonish style.

This pirate is just the beginning. In the coming months, I plan to revisit other characters and further refine the style to give the game a strong, recognizable identity.

I hope you enjoy the new look, here’s a sneak peek below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469725/5c3a6247bf9129308900f6faba1869414dbc87d7.gif[/img]

Thank you for following the journey!

notes.title: Tesla pistol redesign
notes.content:
This month, I’ve been working on redesigning some of the game’s weapons to make them visually more appealing and improve their functionality.

For example, the Tesla pistol now has this new look. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469725/ea7d98caf31dc574c2c82da690aa1e2834d52092.gif[/img]

Essentially, it’s a plasma pistol that fires plasma projectiles, but with the right addons, it can unleash a piercing plasma beam that is especially effective against mechanical enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469725/5585ed2540fdbf816e009e4402d00ef3ac91265a.gif[/img]

When fully upgraded, it features an overheating mechanism that increases the drill’s DPS if activated for an extended duration.

That’s all for today’s updates. 
In the coming months, I’ll keep working hard on the weapons before moving on to improving the enemy models.

Goodbye, everyone, and Merry Christmas! 🎄

notes.title: Latest and Upcoming Changes
notes.content:
In the past month, I’ve made several changes to the game mechanics, the most significant being that melee kills have been transformed into the Purge Fist ability.
The basic idea remains the same: instant kills of nearby undead enemies, consuming the effect of the Vortex Catalyst and restoring the player's health. However, the ability, as it is now conceived, allows for uninterrupted movement and can be activated from a greater distance, which, in my opinion, offers a cleaner and smoother gameplay mechanic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469725/93be915f78153eaab38c8bdfef335582316f461b.gif[/img]
These days, I'm modifying the effect of the first addon in crafting to separate its functionality from the primary fire. I'm therefore adding a secondary fire function that will give me greater flexibility in crafting.

Finally, I plan to revise the ability progression system, but that's a topic for the next update.

With all these changes in the pipeline, the development timeline has extended, and as a solo developer, I’ve had to push the release window from the end of this year to the next. However, I’m confident that this will allow "The Book" to be released with the quality it deserves.

notes.title: Melee Kills in "The Book"
notes.content:
In my game, you can perform melee kills using a sword. The sword instantly kills weaker enemies while regenerating the player's health. Upgrading the sword allows you to kill stronger enemies. Using a melee attack consumes the Vortex Catalyst effect on nearby enemies, dealing them damage. Additionally, the player's health is restored even more when Vortex Catalyst energy is consumed. The sword has a cooldown, which can be reduced by killing enemies with firearms. The cooldown reduction is even faster if the enemies killed are under the effect of the Vortex Catalyst.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469725/cc97ae9810ffbeff060e8894a1947ccc6ed14316.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates and happy gaming!

notes.title: Weapon design philosophy in "The Book
notes.content:
Firearms in "The Book" have a base version and two successive upgrades that add addons. Each addon modifies the weapon's functionalities and increases its effectiveness in combat.

For example, the Gatling Gun, after the first upgrade, has a faster charge time and generates secondary explosions if the enemies hit are under the effect of the grenade. The second addon allows the Gatling Gun to restore the character's health during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469725/54b72c43cd56fbc06b8b3e2154391afc03df8abb.gif[/img]
Finally, crafting allows the tier of each weapon to be increased (from 1 to 5), enhancing its base stats such as damage, range, and fire rate.

notes.title: Grenade: new visuals and gameplay changes
notes.content:
This month, I've listened to players' feedback about the demo, and the main complaints were:

- The grenade throw is not satisfying enough (which is a shame, considering it's one of the main actions of the game).
- Many players find it odd that the grenade effect is required to obtain ammo drops.

I've tackled both issues.

First things first, the visuals. I've spent so much time redesigning the visuals, audio, and feedback of the grenade throw that now it seems 200% better to me. 

Secondly, I've removed the grenade requirement for enemies to drop ammo. Now, enemies drop a small amount of ammo regardless, and using a grenade simply increases the amount of ammo dropped.

Now, the grenade primarily serves as a support weapon, amplifying firearms damage and combining with the sword and certain weapon add-ons.

I'm curious to hear what you think.
Steph

notes.title: Sea of Thieves meets Doom in new indie shooter, playable right now
notes.content:
Just added to Steam to enter early access soon, The Book: Gunsmith's Battles Echoes is an indie boomer shooter FPS that drops the player into a world of pirates, monsters and steampunk technology. Developed and published solely by Stephigames, The Book: Gunsmith's Battles Echoes is stated to be inspired by the recent Doom (2016) and Doom Eternal, creating a frenetic and fast-paced environment in which constantly moving forward and retrieving health and ammunition from corpses is the way to go. It's also just had a demo drop alongside its Steam page, letting you try out the game completely for free. If you wanted a barnacled, pirate-themed shooter - Sea of Thieves with machineguns - this is for you.

notes.title: How the grenade works
notes.content:
In "The Book", the grenade plays a key role in gameplay. Essentially, it has two functions: amplifying weapon damage and providing ammunition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469725/dd8be28cd4098c4d7aa79a8a69d19405c4b5075d.png[/img]

When you throw the grenade at an enemy, they take on a bright orange hue: the grenade has taken effect. In this state, enemies suffer additional damage from weapons. The value of the damage multiplier depends on the level of the grenade itself, which can be increased in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469725/af15ff20aee266cd79f980cda007e68eeb43328c.png[/img]

When an enemy is killed under the effect of the grenade, they will release ammunition for the available weapons.

[previewyoutube=LNz80AGCuTk;full][/previewyoutube]
